# `kpis`

Helper: `kpi(label, value, note, o)`, `kpis(...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Tile` (`tile.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaMetrics` (core:ui), `PemaTile` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Row of 1-6 tiles; each tile: label (label 12, ink-soft) with optional icon, value (metric 27/700, heading), optional unit, note (label 12).

## Variants

- `tone` of the note: neutral, success, warning, danger
- With `unit`, `icon`, `chev`
- With `actions: [btn]` under the note

## States

- A tile that is a link shows no hover change on the canvas; the kit tile is static

## Tokens

surface, line, shadow-card, radius-card, heading, ink-soft, success/warning/danger (note only)

## Do

- Say what the number is in the label
- Colour only the note; the value stays heading colour

## Don't

- Do not colour the value red or green instead of writing the status
- Do not put more than 6 tiles in one row

## Web (1440 and 1920)

N columns in one row, gap 16 (1440) or 20 (1920), padding 19/20.

## Mobile (390)

Two tiles per row, padding 14.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Any count 1-6 in one row (390: 2 per row). Tile = label, value 27/700, note; `unit`, `icon`, `chev`, `tone`, `actions: [btn]`
